384:t_012:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...A failure, then. He turned out less useful than I expected.」

384:t_012:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「You bastard, what did you do to $n!?」

384:t_012:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「He was drawing out the power of the $$スフィア$$ from within the conflicting emotions of hope and despair...」

384:t_012:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「So I fed both of them. ...As a result, he couldn't choose either one, and his mind died. Too bad.」

384:t_012:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「Plus and minus... Unable to move toward either, it all ends up at zero in the end...」

384:t_012:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So this is the $$スフィアの反作用$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$...!」

384:t_012:9.en:
$$桂$$
「Using Miss $$スズネ$$ to trigger it... You play dirty!」

384:t_012:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It's precisely because he had some talent that he ran into this wall.」

384:t_012:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$, who never took it on from the start, was the smarter one.」

384:t_012:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「Shut up! You're the one who broke $n's mind!」

384:t_012:18.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even a dog can bark. If you have time for that, wouldn't you do better to think of a way to turn this situation around?」

384:t_012:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「This hopeless situation, that is.」

384:t_013:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Before you worry about their safety, worry about your own lives.」

384:t_014:2.en:
$$葵$$
「Besides, if we turn our backs on that guy here, we'll just get picked off!」

384:t_014:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「If we time the retreat wrong, we could be wiped out. Above all, any more fighting here would put the townspeople in danger.」

384:t_014:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「And we have to get $n treated...!」

384:t_014:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Do you think I'll let you?」

384:t_015:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「At this rate, we can't even make a retreat!」

384:t_015:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'll dive into his mind and wake $n up!」

384:t_015:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「I don't know... But in the $$時獄戦役$$, I was able to reach the depths of $$グーラ$$'s heart.」

384:t_015:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「If I can get that sensation from back then once more...!」

384:t_016:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「So it's like when $$カグラ$$ and I linked our hearts...!」

384:t_016:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「I don't know how much the $$クアンタ$$ and I can do now, but...!」

384:t_016:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$クアンタム・バースト$$!!」

384:t_018:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「Hold on, $n! I'm coming right now!」

384:t_019:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Time to finish this, $n. If I can't have them, all that's left is to release the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

384:t_020:1.en:
$n
「...$$バルビエル$$. You said you'd kill Miss $$スズネ$$, didn't you?」

384:t_020:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't think it's an empty threat.」

384:t_020:3.en:
$n
「Do it if you can. Go ahead, try.」

384:t_020:5.en:
$n
「You know what happens then, don't you!」

384:t_020:7.en:
$n
「You can't, can you. Miss $$スズネ$$ is your trump card against me. You can't play it that easily.」

384:t_020:8.en:
$n
「Besides, you have no intention of holding Miss $$スズネ$$ hostage! If you did, you'd have brought her here!」

384:t_020:10.en:
$n
「I'm warning you, $$バルビエル$$! If you've already killed Miss $$スズネ$$, I will not forgive you!」

384:t_020:11.en:
$n
「No... I won't forgive you for trying to use Miss $$スズネ$$ in the fight!」

384:t_020:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're in no position to talk big!」

384:t_020:16.en:
$$シン$$
「Show him what your special training did for you!!」

384:t_022:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「That guy tore right through the backlash!」
